Orion deployment operations guide.

The Orion deployment serves the southern platform team.
Its health checks run after each controlled configuration update.
Operators compare the deployment manifest with the approved change record.
The service is isolated from unrelated billing and customer-support systems.
The deployment dashboard records capacity, latency, and availability signals.
Every release is reviewed by two operators before it becomes active.
The rollback procedure keeps the previous image available for one release.
The control room records handoff notes in the regional operations journal.
Routine maintenance is scheduled during the low-traffic observation period.
The team checks certificate expiry and rotates credentials according to policy.
The deployment uses protocol Vega-42.
The deployment region is South Harbor.
The final release note records the owner, timestamp, and approval reference.
